budget_protocol: Each budget is a separate per-arm per-input per-seed timed-run cap, not a total study budget. gpu_s = reserved GPUs multiplied by elapsed process wall, including idle reserved GPUs. Baseline uses one GPU; every candidate uses two. Caps 300/600/1200 gpu_s imply baseline wall caps 300/600/1200 s and method caps 150/300/600 s. Run unchanged full fixed workload at every cap; do not reduce options or paths. No runtime evidence establishes completion. Report wall speedup and GPU-cost speedup separately (GPU-cost speedup=wall speedup/2). A wall gain alone does not imply cost gain.

confidence_details.decision: Declare worthwhile only if performance lower bound strictly >1.05 and equivalence interval entirely within [-tolerance,+tolerance], with target reached by both arms for every seed and no timeout, configuration violation or failed anchor. Zero-margin equivalence requires interval exactly [0,0]. Lack of significance is never equivalence.
confidence_details.exact_bounds: For sorted n observations, choose largest j with Binomial(n,0.5) CDF(j-1)<=alpha; one-sided performance lower bound is x[j]. For two-sided equivalence with M metrics, use alpha=0.05/(2*M) and interval [x[j],x[n-j+1]]. Indices are one-based; absent finite bounds means no claim. Apply performance bounds to 12 timing pairs per seed and to 32 independent seed median ratios; require both. Bonferroni across equivalence metrics, M=1. Each method/budget decision is separate; no claim about the best of selected comparisons.

power.calculation: Worst case all nonzero differences on one side; probability of at least n-j+1 zero differences under Binomial(n,0.9). This powers paired-median binary-verdict equivalence only, not all-seeds acceptance or option-level numeric equivalence. No unconditional power guaranteed without unavailable baseline variability.
power.design_alternative: Assume independent paired seeds and P(signed binary pass difference=0)>=0.9; unmeasured design assumption, not baseline variability evidence. Require both arms pass all seeds as additional acceptance condition.

confidence_details.statistic: Performance ratios are baseline_wall/method_wall; equivalence differences are method sample-pass minus baseline sample-pass. Require each arm to satisfy original reserve/verdict/exit predicate at every completed seed. Record L1 and reserve descriptively only.

specification.environment_pin: Target Ubuntu 22.04 Lambda Stack, CUDA 12.8, driver >=570.26; exact GPU, driver patch, libc and cuRAND versions unavailable. If unable to match streams or environment, invalidate rather than reinterpret as independent seeds.
specification.gpu_rng: Future adapter must assign each option/path shard a stable global identity and cuRAND stream independent of physical device and scheduling; base seed s from sealed paired seeds, disjoint global subsequences for shards, offset zero. Baseline and method consume matched random paths, same total paths. This seed adapter is a prospective requirement, not existing capability. Preserve default upstream seeding in separate 8192-option anchor verification.
specification.host_rng: Pinned sample libc srand/rand generator; S in [5,50], X in [10,25], T in [1,5], R=0.06, V=0.10. For paired seed s, replace host srand(123) by srand(s) identically in both arms through future evaluation adapter. No seed CLI currently exists.

data-parallel over inputs.interval_derivation: low=1/(1-p+p/k_low+h_high); high=min(supplied bound,1/(1-p+p/k_high+h_low)). Added overhead includes launches, host/device transfers, scheduling and result merge; original serial fraction retained.
data-parallel over inputs.method_rationale: Eight logical option partitions scheduled across two GPUs; independent options permit partitioning, but imbalance and repeated launch/transfer/concatenation incur overhead. Factors above two assume additional within-device efficiency; unverified.
data-parallel over inputs.profile_evidence: profile-packet.json: compute stage allocation, RNG setup and streamed pricing occupies p=0.7562792633170974 of process wall; two GPUs reported. No method-specific measurements or representative-scale verification supplied.

ensembles.interval_derivation: low=1/(1-p+p/k_low+h_high); high=min(supplied bound,1/(1-p+p/k_high+h_low)). Added overhead includes launches, host/device transfers, scheduling and result merge; original serial fraction retained.
ensembles.method_rationale: Eight disjoint path shards within each option share exactly 262144 total paths, pooled sufficient statistics reconstruct one estimator and confidence width. No extra paths or independent final answers substituted. Higher merge and RNG bookkeeping overhead assumed. Factors above two require unverified within-device efficiency.
ensembles.profile_evidence: profile-packet.json: compute stage allocation, RNG setup and streamed pricing occupies p=0.7562792633170974 of process wall; two GPUs reported. No method-specific measurements or representative-scale verification supplied.

multi-GPU.method_rationale: Two physical GPUs give factor at most two. Discovery and host validation remain serial; launch, transfer, load imbalance and result merge reduce benefit.

repetition_protocol: One full untimed warmup per arm per input/seed/budget before 12 timing pairs. Use identical inputs and paired random streams in each pair; reset RNG state, synchronize GPUs and wait for completion. Randomize baseline/method order independently for each pair using scheduling seed 41773, iterating methods in prediction order, budgets ascending, seeds in listed order, then repetitions ascending. No concurrent arms or resource contention. Aggregate timing-pair ratios by median within each seed, then median over seeds. Equivalence has one independent observation per seed; timing repetitions are not additional scientific replicates.
seal_rule: Protocol fixed before method code. Changes to scope, seeds, budgets, timing, targets or tolerances require new sealed run.

splits.development: Published 8192-option seed-123 anchor only; excluded from primary timing and equivalence sample.
splits.rule: All 32 seed pairs reserved for final evaluation; no tuning, seed selection, early stopping or replacement after observing outcomes. No training data; generated options validated against analytic Black-Scholes.

timing_scope.description: Monotonic process launch through successful exit and collection/merge of all results, with adapter synchronizing all participating GPUs before completion. Includes device discovery, generation, allocation, RNG initialization, launches, H2D/D2H transfers, pricing, all scheduling and merge, CPU finalization, Black-Scholes validation and cleanup. Excludes compilation and warmup. This process scope matches supplied profile more closely than upstream reported pricing-only timer. Record upstream Total time separately; never substitute it for primary wall time.
